prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ONLY_CWT_catboost', seasonality_champion='ARIMA', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: ONLY_CWT_catboost dominates with perfect trend correlation (1.0) and lowest RMSE (407.8), while ARIMA leads seasonality capture (0.5245). The extreme RMSE spread ratio (9.72) and high seasonality variance indicate significant model disagreement, making STL-hierarchical stacking ideal to exploit the additive decomposition and leverage both champions. Concept drift detected suggests dynamic weighting over static ridge fitting.
